context: A casual video call among three old friends, Dan (the Natively user), Priya and Tom. About half the call is catch-up and banter (a TV finale, five-a-side football, Priya's new puppy, work complaints); interleaved throughout is the planning of a 3-night cabin trip for their friend Maya's 30th birthday, plus a secret surprise visit from Maya's brother.

facts.statement: The friends are planning a 3-night cabin trip to celebrate Maya's 30th birthday.
Maya's actual 30th birthday is Wednesday, October 21st.
The chosen location is Heron Point Cabin at Birchwater Lake, listed on Hearthstay, chosen over Hollins Ridge.
Birchwater Lake is about a 3-hour drive, versus about 4.5 hours to Hollins Ridge.
Heron Point Cabin has a hot tub and three bedrooms, sleeps six, and is right on the water.
The trip dates are Friday, October 23rd to Monday, October 26th.
The trip moved off the October 16th weekend because Priya (Speaker 1) is on night shifts that Friday, Saturday and Sunday and cannot swap, having already swapped twice this month.
The new weekend is two days after Maya's birthday; Maya also has a big work presentation on Friday the 16th.
The total cabin cost for three nights including fees is $1,140, and it is the same price for the October 23rd-26th dates.
The cabin is $325 a night plus fees; the initial total omitted the cleaning fee.
Maya does not pay for the cabin because it is her birthday; the cost is split among the friends who attend.
With Mia unconfirmed, the $1,140 cabin cost is split among Dan, Priya and Tom at $380 each.
If Mia confirms she is coming, the split goes back down to $285 each (four payers).
Mia Chen (Priya's book-club friend, not Maya) cannot do the October 23rd weekend because of her cousin's wedding on Saturday the 24th in Portland; she might come for the Sunday but is unconfirmed.
facts.notes: supersedes early 'Mia said she's probably in' (C08)

facts.statement: Priya will get a firm yes or no from Mia by Sunday.
Dan books the cabin on Hearthstay, taking over from Priya.
facts.notes: owner change: Priya originally offered to book (C04)

facts.statement: Priya could not book because her $150 Hearthstay credit expired on September 1st and her card was flagged previously.
The deposit is 50% ($570) and is due by Friday, September 25th; after that the hold on the dates drops.
facts.notes: supersedes Dan's earlier guess 'end of the month' (C05)

facts.statement: Dan will pay the whole $570 deposit on his card and book before Friday, probably tomorrow.
Priya will send Dan her $190 share of the deposit tonight.
Tom will send Dan his $190 share of the deposit by Wednesday, September 23rd (not the October 23rd trip start).
The remaining $570 is charged automatically two weeks before check-in.
Tom rents a seven-seat SUV from Ridgeway and will book it by October 1st.
Ridgeway SUVs cost about $64 a day.
Departure is 9:30 on Friday, October 23rd: Tom picks up the SUV and everyone meets at Priya's place on Calloway Street.
facts.notes: implicitly supersedes Tom's 'pick everyone up at like 8' (C06)

facts.statement: Tom will pick up Maya on the way to Priya's, since Maya lives two streets over from him.
Maya is celiac and strictly gluten-free; cross-contamination matters (separate toaster and chopping board).
facts.notes: corrects Tom's false assumption that Maya is vegetarian

facts.statement: Mia, not Maya, is the vegetarian.
Heron Point Cabin allows no pets of any kind (with a $250 fee if pet hair is found), so Priya's puppy Waffles cannot come.
facts.notes: corrects Priya's assumption that the listing was pet friendly

facts.statement: Priya will ask her sister Anjali to look after Waffles that weekend.
The group decided against hiring a private chef (about $600) for the Saturday birthday dinner; they will cook themselves.
Tom will cook Saturday dinner, a gluten-free lasagna.
Surprise: Maya's brother Jonah is flying in from Denver, landing on the afternoon of Saturday the 24th, to walk in right before dinner.
Jonah's visit must stay completely secret from Maya: nothing in the birthday group chat (Maya is in it), only in the separate chat Operation Heron.
Priya created the Operation Heron chat and will add Dan and Tom after the call.
The group gift is the green Polaroid camera ($179), with a gift budget of $60 each ($180 total).
Priya buys the Polaroid, ordering it by October 16th; Dan and Tom each send her $60.
Tom's last day at Pellmark is October 9th.
Tom starts as a senior financial analyst at Halvorsen Logistics on Monday, November 2nd.
Halvorsen is hybrid (two days from home) and will pay for Tom's CFA level two certification if he wants it.
Priya is moving to day shifts in November.
Dan's rent is going up $200 a month when his lease renews in January, and he is apartment hunting.
Priya has an 11-week-old beagle puppy named Waffles.
Everyone travels together in one car rather than driving separately (Dan does not trust his car).
The trip stays at three nights; Tom's idea of a fourth night to Tuesday was dropped because Priya works Tuesday.
Open: whether Mia will come at all.
Open: how Jonah gets from the airport to the cabin (about three hours away; the group's only car will be at the lake).
Open: whether to rent kayaks on Birchwater (about $45 per person for a half day).
Nobody has checked for a grocery store near the cabin that stocks gluten-free food; raised as 'someone should' with no owner.
Someone should make a playlist for the drive; no owner (Tom explicitly declined).
Jonah has not seen Maya in about fourteen months, since he moved to Denver.
